title: A Spectral-Domain Pseudo-Inverse Method for True 3D Gravity Inversion
summary: The main difficulty in 3D gravity inversion is that surface observations lack vertical wavenumber information, making the problem underdetermined and depth resolution poor. Building on the author's spectral-domain pseudo-inverse theory for unitary diagonalizable systems, this paper presents a true 3D inversion method. Surface data are analytically continued upward via Laplace's equation to form a 3D data volume, providing the vertical wavenumber sampling for the 3D Fourier transform.
